idea: Signs of a hidden water leak
title: Is Your Home Hiding a Water Leak?
description: Water leaks do not always happen with a dramatic burst pipe. Many occur quietly behind walls or under floors, leading to costly structural damage over time. To catch hidden leaks early, watch for subtle red flags around your home. An unexplained jump in your monthly water bill is often the first warning sign. You might also notice damp spots on drywall, peeling paint, musty odors, or the faint sound of running water when all faucets are off. If you observe any of these symptoms, avoid waiting for visible water damage to appear. Scheduling a professional leak detection inspection can help pinpoint the exact location and protect your property.
